Original brief: read all research/hypotheses/W016.md. Independently audit the parent sparse-progression transfer p=1+m*t, beta=alpha^m, D=A(0)-qN, e=A(t)-qN/p, beta^D=beta^e modulo p. Audit nonzero recovery (1+mT)(A(T)-e')-qN and growing-degree/bit/order caveats. Determine exact relation to supplied residue-class factoring and p-1 methods, using only primary papers for technical prior-art claims; don't claim novelty absent thorough support.

Prior results: W014-parent-disposition.md accepts dense-grid rigidity and full polynomial-image obstruction at their scoped assumptions, not sparse domains. W013-hidden-period-consumer.md and its disposition accept a conditional shared error consumer with all acquisition, component-order, global collision recovery and prime-power guards. Do not re-audit those entire results. W015-routing-review.md accepts monic simultaneous product/recovery over composites with finite caps and H! unit precheck; parent W015-valuation-compression.md is a separate unaudited representation lemma and need not be audited here.

Main task: full cost comparison against the elementary product over the SAME supplied progression (length L, cost O~sqrt L), and exact unsupported coverage/acquisition premise. Does changing sparse grid and base remove actual work beyond receiving extra information? Analyze a proposed family of varying m versus common powered-base sharing: state feasible common-base construction and its order loss, or explain why no gain follows from the supplied input. Do not turn lack of construction into an all-algorithm lower bound. A factor p=1 mod m is a promise for this primitive, not an N-only solver.
If feasible, derive an explicit corrected conditional consumer statement and a sharpened break-even inequality comparing K certificate errors with total progression lengths. Account ceilings and additive record costs. One useful constructive direction is a paid family whose shared product/collision operations beat applying the comparator separately; naming such a family without constructing it is not a result.

Prefer symbolic analysis and narrow primary-art verification. No experiment needed; any indispensable exact certificate must first preregister cases/code/budget, preserve failures, single run <=60sec and20000 events. No parameter searches. Distinguish known primitive, conditional new representation, finite evidence, complete bound. Verified new complete factoring improvement remains NONE. Deliver precise accepted/repaired/rejected scope, input/output hashes, and a concrete next computation rather than review volume.
